note: Rejudged after 438bb234e4 changed handleLCPPacket's Code-Reject and Protocol-Reject handling (RXJ+/RXJ- by rejected Code or protocol, stopRejectedCode, lcpRejectFatalReason). Re-read Section 5.4: 'On reception of a Configure-Reject, the Identifier field MUST match that of the last transmitted Configure-Request.' A Configure-Reject still passes ValidateLCPReply's Identifier check before the lcpRejectedMRU/lcpRejectedMagic flags are set, all byte-identical, and a Configure-Reject (Code 4) never enters the Code-Reject (Code 7) branches. The tagged units are unchanged. A Reject of the requested MRU under the wrong Identifier still leaves the FSM and wire, or the client completion and output, unchanged. A matching Identifier still makes the next request omit the option, and the client still covers MRU-only, Magic-only and whole-request Rejects before completing on an exact replacement Ack. The verdict holds.
